title: My Town
text:
I live in a small town. In the middle of the town there is a big square. There is a post office next to the square. My school is near the post office. Every morning I walk to school.

On Sunday, my family goes to the zoo. The zoo is far from our house, so we take a bus. We see lions and monkeys. After the zoo, we eat ice cream in the square.

questions.text: What is in the middle of the town?
How does the family go to the zoo?
What kind of day does the family probably have on Sunday?
Why do they probably take a bus to the zoo?
options: The bus is free for everyone

vocabulary.definition: a large open area in a town, often with buildings around it
a place where you send letters and parcels
a place where wild animals are kept so people can see them
a place where children go to learn

paragraph_translations: Küçük bir kasabada yaşıyorum. Kasabanın ortasında büyük bir meydan var. Meydanın yanında bir postane var. Okulum postanenin yakınında. Her sabah okula yürürüm.
Pazar günü ailem hayvanat bahçesine gider. Hayvanat bahçesi evimizden uzakta, bu yüzden otobüse binderiz. Aslanları ve maymunları görürüz. Hayvanat bahçesinden sonra meydanda dondurma yeriz.
